===============
Simple triples
===============

<http://example.org/#spiderman> <http://www.perceive.net/schemas/relationship/enemyOf> <http://example.org/#green-goblin> .

---

(n3_doc
  (n3_statement
    (triples
      (subject
        (expression
          (path
            (path_item
              (iri_reference)))))
      (predicate_object_list
        (verb
          (predicate
            (expression
              (path
                (path_item
                  (iri_reference))))))
        (object_list
          (object
            (expression
              (path
                (path_item
                  (iri_reference))))))))))
